formal_statement: ∀ (m n k : ℕ) (y : Fin m × Fin m → ℂ), MvPolynomial.eval y (PEqualNP.Gct.permPoly ℂ m) = 0 → (∀ L : Submodule ℂ (Fin m × Fin m → ℂ), (∀ t ∈ L, MvPolynomial.eval (y + t) (PEqualNP.Gct.permPoly ℂ m) = 0) → Module.finrank ℂ L ≤ k) → PEqualNP.Gct.HasBorderDetExpression (PEqualNP.Gct.permPoly ℂ m) n → m ^ 2 ≤ k + n
plain_statement: If y is a zero of perm_m and every linear space L with y+L in {perm_m = 0} has dim at most k, then every BORDER determinantal expression of perm_m has size n >= m^2 - k. Proof: zeros y_k of det A_k converge to y (root persistence on a line, as in L-gct-010); L_k = {t : (sum t_ij A_k,ij) u_k = 0} has dim >= m^2 - n with y_k + L_k in {det A_k = 0}; orthonormal bases converge on a subsequence to a space L of the same dim; perm(y + t) = lim det A_k(y_k + t_k) = 0. The kernel vectors u_k may diverge; they are never used in the limit.
title: Border subspace reduction: L-gct-035 holds for border determinantal expressions
